description: In a well-order of cofinality other than aleph zero, a union of fewer than its cofinality many sets is stationary exactly when one set is stationary.
signature:
isStationary_iUnion_iff.{u, v} {α : Type v} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] {ι : Type u} {f : ι → Set α}
  (hα : Order.cof α ≠ Cardinal.aleph0)
  (hι : Cardinal.lift.{v, u} (Cardinal.mk ι) < Cardinal.lift.{u, v} (Order.cof α)) :
  IsStationary (⋃ i, f i) ↔ ∃ i, IsStationary (f i)
